name: codex-voice-reply-plugin
description: Codex plugin and local helpers for Mandarin voice replies, project-specific voice strategies, and cross-platform TTS.

interface.shortDescription: Speak Mandarin result summaries and route voice behavior by project.
interface.longDescription: Codex Voice Reply adds a voice-reply skill, local TTS helpers, project-specific reading strategies, voice identity profiles, silence rules, and Windows/macOS playback support. The default neural voice profile is 02-anime-soft-loli-character: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural at rate +5% and pitch +5Hz.
interface.defaultPrompt: Before final written responses, follow the voice-reply skill: honor project voice settings, speak required Mandarin summaries when enabled, and stay silent when the project disables voice.
